"""mindmap_work_history — fetch the append-only history of a work item."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mem_mcp.db import tenant_tx
from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._base import BaseTool, ToolContext
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._mindmap_common import resolve_team_id
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._work_item_common import (
    WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput,
    map_work_item_error,
)
from mem_mcp.mindmap import work_items as work_item_service


class MindmapWorkHistoryInput(BaseModel):
    """Input for fetching a work item's history."""

    map_key: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    node_id: UUID
    team_id: UUID | None = Field(default=None)


class MindmapWorkHistoryTool(BaseTool):
    """Fetch the append-only history of a work item."""

    name: ClassVar[str] = "mindmap_work_history"
    description: ClassVar[str] = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS["mindmap_work_history"]
    required_scope: ClassVar[str] = "memory.read"
    InputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkHistoryInput
    OutputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput

    async def __call__(self, ctx: ToolContext, inp: BaseModel) -> BaseModel:
        assert isinstance(inp, MindmapWorkHistoryInput)

        async with tenant_tx(ctx.db_pool, ctx.tenant_id) as conn:
            team_id = await resolve_team_id(conn, ctx, inp.team_id)

            try:
                entries = await work_item_service.get_work_item_history(
                    conn,
                    tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    team_id=team_id,
                    map_key=inp.map_key,
                    node_id=inp.node_id,
                )
            except work_item_service.WorkItemError as e:
                raise map_work_item_error(e) from e

            out = [
                WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput(
                    id=e.id,
                    memory_id=e.memory_id,
                    change_type=e.change_type,
                    kind_before=e.kind_before,
                    kind_after=e.kind_after,
                    status_before=e.status_before,
                    status_after=e.status_after,
                    assignee_before=e.assignee_before,
                    assignee_after=e.assignee_after,
                    actor_id=e.actor_id,
                    channel=e.channel,
                    reason=e.reason,
                    created_at=e.created_at,
                    stage_before=e.stage_before,
                    stage_after=e.stage_after,
                    workflow_id=e.workflow_id,
                )
                for e in entries
            ]
            return out  # type: ignore[return-value]
